title: Should Children Clean Their Own Rooms?
source_body:
I think children should clean their own rooms. I have three reasons.
First, it is our own space. We use our rooms every day, so we should take care of them.
Second, cleaning helps us become responsible. When I clean my room by myself, I learn to put things back in the right place. Now I don't lose my things often.
Third, it helps our parents. Parents are very busy at work and at home. If we clean our rooms, they can rest a little more.
Some people say children are too busy with homework. But cleaning a room doesn't take a long time. Just fifteen minutes a day is enough.
So, let's clean our own rooms. It is good for us and for our families!

variants.prestudy:
In my opinion, children should be responsible for cleaning their own rooms, and there are three main reasons why I believe this.
First of all, a bedroom is a personal space. Since we spend time in our rooms every day, it is only natural that we should be the ones to take care of them.
Second, cleaning teaches us responsibility. Ever since I started cleaning my room by myself, I have learned to put things back where they belong. As a result, I rarely lose my belongings anymore.
Third, it lightens our parents' load. Most parents are busy not only at work but also at home. If we take care of our own rooms, they can have a little more time to relax.
Some people argue that children are too busy with homework to clean their rooms. However, keeping a room tidy doesn't require much time. Spending just fifteen minutes a day is enough.
So, why not start cleaning our own rooms today? Doing so benefits not only ourselves but also our families!
